prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Tombsands: dusk over a sand-buried necropolis, sunken tombs and pale cliffs. A mysterious elegy with flute and harp that resolves gently. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 2 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
